drafts.lead: Sumeet Kumar, Axtella Consulting (India) — 'Sure. Let us know when we can connect'. Booked Naufal Wed 12 Aug 2:30 PM IST
drafts.body:
Sumeet,

Good. I have put us down for Wednesday, August 12 at 2:30 PM IST. The invite is in your inbox with the video link on it.

Naufal from our team will take the call, and he is in Jakarta, so the timing works properly on both sides rather than one of us dialling in at midnight.

Thirty minutes. The useful part will be deciding which data leaders to go after first, because BI dashboard work and broader analytics support attract quite different buyers and the outreach has to pick one to be any good.

If Wednesday does not suit, reply here and I will move it.

Hannah

drafts.lead: Jake, Morgan Transfer (United Van Lines agent) — 'I cannot access your website. Are you a legit company?'
drafts.body:
Jake,

Fair question, and you were right to ask it.

The company is Koldify: koldify.io, and https://koldify.io/#results is the quickest way to judge us. I am Courtney and I work there.

The address I wrote from is a sending domain we use for outreach rather than a website, which is why there was nothing to look at. Standard practice for campaigns like this, and it does look odd if you go checking, so the question was reasonable.

What we would do for Morgan Transfer is run outbound to corporate HR and facilities managers planning employee relocations and office moves, under your name, so those enquiries come to you directly.

If it is worth twenty minutes:

• Monday, August 17 at 1:30 PM EDT
• Tuesday, August 18 at 1:30 PM EDT

And if you would rather look at the site first and decide later, that is completely fair.

Courtney Stewart
Koldify
